events.title: STE Q4 Earnings & Revenues Miss, Stock Dips in Aftermarket Trading
events.body: STERIS posts Q4 adjusted EPS of $2.83 and revenues of $1.59 billion, both slight misses; shares dip after hours despite broad growth and exercice 2027 guidance.

events.title: HAE Stock Gains on Q4 Earnings & Revenue Beat, Gross Margin Cut
events.body: Haemonetics beats Q4 EPS and revenue estimates, shares rise 1.4%, but gross margin falls 120 basis points as the company sets its exercice 2027 growth outlook.
